title.from: Recurring Monitors deliver attributable morning discoveries to real classifiers
title.to: Run recurring discovery through real prediction, human review and applied learning receipt

description.from:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a publication editor, I want recurring intake from a few real configured sources to reach my publication classifiers, so that I can review relevant new and updated discoveries each morning.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Recurring Monitors deliver attributable morning discoveries to real classifiers
  Scenario: Repeated collection and classification
    Given 3–5 validated real sources are configured for the academic Papyrus publication, Threat Intelligence and Anth.us through common Papyrus Monitors
    And each consumer has its actual authorized Cyclotron classifier binding and current guidance
    When recurring Monitor runs execute at their configured source-appropriate cadence, around 15 minutes where permitted
    Then new and meaningfully updated source items pass through existing intake and canonical deduplication
    And resumable checkpoints and source observation/revision provenance are retained
    And actual classifier decisions retain publication scope, classifier/model identity, input revision, decision identity and relevant guidance provenance
    And the morning review can inspect the resulting discoveries and classification evidence
    And a manually researched candidate list alone does not satisfy this scenario
    And agent discovery or classification never silently creates a human training label
  Scenario: Resume and report partial failures
    Given a recurring run stops after processing some source items
    When the run resumes or retries from its recorded checkpoint
    Then unchanged items are not duplicated and changed items retain update history
    And failed or pending collection, intake and classifier stages remain distinguishable and visible
    And a classifier failure is not presented as successful classification
    And source-specific limits and backoff are respected
  Scenario: Keep the slice independent of outbound publishing
    Given Markus authored-page migration, outbound feeds, headless delivery or email monitoring are not complete
    When the recurring feed or crawler slice is evaluated
    Then those unrelated features do not block Monitoring acceptance
    And all three publications use the shared capability with their own authorized configurations
```

Latest priority and initial consumers: inbound Monitoring is Ryan's highest near-term value, independent of Markus for everything, outbound RSS/Atom and headless delivery. Initial consumers are the academic Papyrus publication, Threat Intelligence AND Anth.us, configured through the same publication-agnostic Papyrus capability rather than special implementations. Morning relevant discoveries must reach the actual configured Cyclotron classifiers with attributable classification evidence; a manual research list alone is not completion. No automatic human labels. No blocking dependency on the Markus initiative, outgoing feeds, authored-page migration or email-monitor implementation is introduced.

First small vertical slice: validate and configure 3–5 real sources across those consumers, prioritizing Hacker News, arXiv AI papers, the current Hugging Face paper offering, security/privacy publications and CVE/advisory sources. Final source/publication bindings are verified, not inferred. Cadence is configurable around 15 minutes where source limits and update frequency permit, with checkpoints, deduplication, new/updated-item handling, provenance and visible retryable failures. The desired “tonight or tomorrow” urgency expresses value, not permission to deploy or start coding.

Source validation evidence from this planning pass: https://huggingface.co/papers currently identifies Daily Papers (daily/weekly/monthly views) and offers email subscription; no official RSS feed, stable API contract or Papers With Code successor status was established. Validate an allowed feed/API/crawler method before selecting it. Official arXiv RSS/Atom documentation https://info.arxiv.org/help/rss.html describes subject feeds and daily updates; its cadence need not be 15 minutes. Review current source terms/rate/access requirements before implementation. HN candidates remain https://news.ycombinator.com/rss and https://github.com/HackerNews/API . No subscriptions, mailbox connections, model calls or paid access in this task.

Future acceptance must include observed recurring execution and real classifier receipts, not only mocks or manual research. Source/model runs require later implementation authorization. Current publication keys, deployment availability and classifier capability remain verification work.

Discovery inbox acceptance: PPY-b83f2bf0-7443-46d1-b169-5332f508efeb requires usable publication-wide, channel (e.g. all configured X/Reddit/email), individual-Monitor and section lenses over the same deduplicated References and multiple associations. Show “found by this section's Monitors” provenance separately from “relevant to this section” classifier output. Reuse Reference preview/curation and Cyclotron confidence/label controls under existing human/delegation/agent-advisory authority rules, and link Editorial triage. Settings CRUD alone is insufficient. Document and review lenses, failures and authority semantics without claiming unimplemented source adapters exist.
description.to:
As a publication editor, I want recurring source discoveries to reach real classifiers and the existing human learning loop, so that each morning I can review relevant material and verify authorized feedback was applied.

LATEST first milestone and implementation scope: real recurring Monitor -> persisted deduplicated References and provenance -> the correct publication's REAL Cyclotron prediction -> human review in the EXISTING curation UI -> an authorized human label under current authority rules -> verified applied steering/training receipt. Predictions, agent judgments and advisory feedback never count as human labels. Recorded, queued and applied feedback are distinct; claim training/optimization only with an applied receipt, never from prediction alone. Respect existing proof/authorization gates; do not bypass them to manufacture a receipt.

One configured Monitor per initial publication is sufficient. Start with 1–2 source adapters: Hacker News first, then a verified current Hugging Face paper/academic source only as a useful bounded increment. Initial consumers are Anth.us, the academic Papyrus publication and Threat Intelligence; exact source-to-publication mapping is flexible and one upstream source may serve multiple independently scoped classifiers. Verify current application/binding ownership and guidance; never assume legacy dbsyytcm9drqa. Pilobolus is not an initial target because its serendipitous content is harder to monitor, not because it is permanently excluded. Preserve recurring, source-appropriate cadence around 15 minutes, checkpoints, dedup/new/updated items, provenance and visible stage failures so relevant discoveries and the learning loop are available for morning review.

Rich Monitoring UI/new inbox, email/unsubscribe, expensive LLM section/desk triage and Markus for everything are MUCH LOWER priority and MUST NOT block this slice. Use existing capabilities and curation UI; choose the operator/configuration interface during implementation, with no required new configuration UI. Additional adapters, 3–5 source expansion and richer views are later increments. Reuse current scheduling/intake/classification/label paths and coordinate intake PR367 instead of duplicating it.

Ryan explicitly authorized implementation of THIS first slice after filing, with public-source intake/classification needed for it. That does not authorize production merge/deployment, new persistent access/IAM, purchases, mailbox/MX changes, subscriptions, AWS-console browser work or unrelated benchmarks. No fabricated human labels. Other new feature plans remain unstarted.

Acceptance behavior:
```gherkin
Feature: First recurring Monitoring learning slice
  Scenario: Persist and classify recurring discoveries for an initial publication
    Given one configured Monitor for Anth.us, the academic Papyrus publication or Threat Intelligence using a verified current binding
    And the initial adapter is Hacker News, with an optional verified academic adapter as a bounded increment
    When recurring source-appropriate runs execute and resume from checkpoints
    Then new and meaningfully updated source items become persisted canonically deduplicated References with discovery and revision provenance
    And the correct publication's real Cyclotron prediction records input revision, classifier/model identity, decision identity and guidance provenance
    And the discoveries and prediction evidence are available in the existing curation UI for morning human review
  Scenario: Verify the existing human learning loop
    Given a real current prediction is visible in the existing curation UI
    When an authorized human reviews it and records a label under current authority rules
    And the existing feedback path applies that review to the correct classifier
    Then its receipt distinguishes recorded, queued and applied states
    And steering or training is claimed only when an applied receipt is verified
    And predictions, agent judgments and advisory feedback are not substituted for a human label
  Scenario: Preserve truthful failure and checkpoint behavior
    Given collection, intake, classification or feedback application fails partway through
    When the operation is inspected or retried
    Then its failed or pending stage is visible and recoverable
    And retries resume without duplicate canonical References or duplicate label application
    And a missing prediction or applied receipt is not reported as success
  Scenario: Keep the first slice small and independent
    Given rich Monitoring UI, a new inbox, email/unsubscribe, expensive desk triage and Markus work remain incomplete
    When the recurring source-to-human-learning slice is accepted
    Then none of those later features is required to pass
    And the existing curation UI and supported operator capabilities are sufficient
    And one upstream source may feed more than one correctly scoped publication classifier
```
